package flowexperiment

import (
	"context"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/contracts"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/dimen"
	"github.com/npillmayer/typography/glyphing"
	fontot "github.com/npillmayer/typography/glyphing/adapter/opentype"
	"github.com/npillmayer/typography/glyphing/paragraph"
	"github.com/npillmayer/uax/bidi"
)

// Real faces stay concrete only inside the adapter. This instrumentation wraps
// services, never faces, and forwards the original ShapeParams unchanged.
type e3Stream struct {
	contracts.StreamingShaper
	calls *serviceCalls
}

func (s e3Stream) CheckFace(f contracts.FontFace) error {
	s.calls.hit(3)
	return s.StreamingShaper.CheckFace(f)
}
func (s e3Stream) Shape(ctx context.Context, p contracts.ShapeParams, r contracts.RuneReader, o contracts.ShapeBufferOptions) error {
	s.calls.hit(2)
	return s.StreamingShaper.Shape(ctx, p, r, o)
}

type e3Fixture struct {
	backend  string
	input    paragraph.Input
	config   khipu.Config
	request  paragraph.LayoutRequest
	prepared *paragraph.Prepared
	seed     *paragraph.FlowSeed
	initial  *paragraph.Result
	calls    *serviceCalls
	key      reuseKey
}

var e3LargeReal = flag.Bool("flow-e3-large-real", false, "include the expensive 10,000-word real-font pilot cases")

func e3Input(t testing.TB, backend string, words int, fixed bool) (paragraph.Input, khipu.Config, *serviceCalls) {
	t.Helper()
	calls := new(serviceCalls)
	vocabulary := []string{"alpha", "beta", "gamma", "delta", "epsilon", "zeta", "eta", "theta", "iota", "kappa"}
	if fixed {
		vocabulary = []string{"aa"}
	} else if backend == "hebrew" {
		// Pure Hebrew avoids the separately documented mixed-RTL admission/stall cases.
		vocabulary = []string{"אב", "גד", "הו", "זח", "טי"}
	}
	tokens := make([]string, words)
	for i := range tokens {
		tokens[i] = vocabulary[i%len(vocabulary)]
	}
	raw := strings.Join(tokens, " ")
	if backend == "synthetic" {
		return textInput(raw), flowConfig(calls), calls
	}
	path := "../../../opentype/testdata/fonts/GentiumPlus-R.ttf"
	if backend == "hebrew" {
		path = "../../../opentype/testdata/fonts/NotoSansHebrew-Regular.ttf"
	} else if backend != "gentium" {
		t.Fatal("unknown backend", backend)
	}
	entry, err := (fontot.Services{}).Load(t.Context(), path, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err) // Missing offline fixtures must never silently skip a sample.
	}
	mapper, err := glyphing.NewStyleMapper(t.Context(), glyphing.SelectedFonts{
		Faces: []glyphing.FaceEntry{entry}, Default: entry.Info.ResourceID, Size: 10 * dimen.BP,
	}, fontot.Services{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	text, _, err := mapper.Itemize(t.Context(), raw, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	params := khipu.DefaultParams()
	params.SpaceShrinkPercent, params.SpaceStretchPercent = 0, 0
	config := khipu.Config{Params: &params, Streaming: &khipu.StreamingConfig{
		Resolver: mapper, Defaults: mapper.Defaults(),
		NewShaper: func() (contracts.StreamingShaper, error) {
			calls.hit(1)
			s, err := fontot.NewStream(8)
			return e3Stream{s, calls}, err
		},
	}}
	in := paragraph.Input{Text: text}
	if backend == "hebrew" {
		in.Direction = bidi.RightToLeft
	}
	return in, config, calls
}

func e3Prepare(t testing.TB, input paragraph.Input, config khipu.Config) *paragraph.Prepared {
	t.Helper()
	p, err := paragraph.Prepare(t.Context(), input, khipu.PrepareOptions{Hyphenation: khipu.NoHyphenation}, config)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return p
}

func newE3Fixture(t testing.TB, backend string, words int, fixed bool) *e3Fixture {
	t.Helper()
	input, cfg, calls := e3Input(t, backend, words, fixed)
	p := e3Prepare(t, input, cfg)
	req := flowRequest(paragraph.FirstFit)
	req.Params.Constraints.Width = 300 * dimen.BP
	if fixed {
		req.Params.Constraints.Width = 145 * dimen.BP // Exactly ten synthetic "aa" words.
	}
	req.Params.LineLayout.Default.Factor = 1.2
	seed, err := p.FlowStart(t.Context(), req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	initial := seed.Initial()
	key := reuseKey{width: req.Params.Constraints.Width, source: 1, styles: 1, fonts: 1, lineHeight: 1, atomics: 1, policy: 1}
	return &e3Fixture{backend, input, cfg, req, p, seed, initial, calls, key}
}

// The bounded repeated matrix keeps the large case synthetic. The initial
// real-font 10,000-word pilot is reported separately, never silently averaged.
func e3Sizes(backend string) []int {
	if backend == "synthetic" || *e3LargeReal {
		return []int{100, 1000, 10000}
	}
	return []int{100, 1000}
}

func (f *e3Fixture) cut(percent int) (int, float64) {
	lines := f.initial.VList.Lines()
	n := max(1, min(len(lines)-1, len(lines)*percent/100))
	last := lines[n-1]
	return n, last.Top + last.Height
}

// Admission is untimed and uses E2's complete frozen/prefix/source oracle. This
// prevents a faster failure, dropped tail or changed prefix from becoming a sample.
func e3Admit(t testing.TB, f *e3Fixture, cut int, height float64) {
	t.Helper()
	width := f.key.width * 3 / 4
	before := f.calls.snapshot()
	ref, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), f.prepared, f.seed, height, width, 30000, false)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), f.prepared, f.seed, height, width, 30000, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	compareFlow(t, f.initial, ref, got, cut, width)
	if got.status != complete || len(got.overfull) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("benchmark requires complete horizontal/vertical fit")
	}
	noBaseShaping(t, before, f.calls.snapshot())
	f.calls.sealed.Store(true)
	equal, err := splitEqual(t.Context(), f.initial.VList, f.key, frame{f.key, height}, frame{f.key, 30000})
	f.calls.sealed.Store(false)
	if err != nil || equal.status != complete || len(equal.overfull) != 0 || equal.a.Range().End != cut {
		t.Fatal("equal-width benchmark admission", err)
	}
}

func TestE3BenchmarkAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	for _, backend := range []string{"synthetic", "gentium", "hebrew"} {
		t.Run(backend, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newE3Fixture(t, backend, 60, false)
			for _, percent := range []int{10, 50, 90} {
				cut, height := f.cut(percent)
				e3Admit(t, f, cut, height)
			}
			cp, err := f.seed.Checkpoint(t.Context(), 1)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var timing paragraph.FlowTiming
			plain, _, err := f.prepared.FlowContinue(t.Context(), f.seed, cp, f.key.width*3/4, true)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			timed, _, err := f.prepared.FlowContinue(paragraph.FlowTimingContext(t.Context(), &timing), f.seed, cp, f.key.width*3/4, true)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			compareCompleted(t, plain, timed)
			if timing.Bind <= 0 || timing.Break <= 0 || timing.Freeze <= 0 || timing.Assembly <= 0 {
				t.Fatal("missing measured phase", timing)
			}
		})
	}
}

func e3Name(backend string, words int) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%s/N%d", backend, words) }
